title: Hussain Aapka Chehloom
body:
Sitam ki Qaid se chhut kar ye Jab Haram aaye..
Watan ko Jayega ye Qunba karbala hokar..
Lahed Jo bhai ki dekhi to keh uthi se Zainab..
tadap ke ashq bahati thi Noha tha Lab par...
*Hussain Aapka Chehlum Manaane Aayi hu..*
*Sahe hai dard jo Hamne Batane aayi hu...*
Tumhare Bad wo Bhaiyaa Sitam huwe Humpar..
Chalaya KantoN Pe Zalim ne Maare hai pathhar..
Nishan chhaloN Ke Tumko Dikhaane Aayi hu..
Rasan me Bara Gale the Na Sar pe thi Chadar...
Tamasha karte the Zalim Hamara Has Has kar..
Tamam RaahoN ke Kisse Sunane aayi hu.
Mila hai Ajr e Risalat ye qalma go se hame
RidayeN Loot Li, Sadqe khajoor ke Phenke..
DiloN me bugz hai kitna Batane Aayi hu..
Kadi thi Dhoop ye beemar Ghash me Aata tha...
Sina ki Nauk se Usko Jagaya Jata tha...
Bacha ke Bete ko tere Sirhaane Aayi hu...
Kadam kadam pa Tamache hai shimr ne maare..
Safedi baalo me, Rukhsaar ho gaye Nile...
Sakina Mar Gayi pyaasi batane Aayi Hu...
Sakina Kehti thi Karbobala agar jana...
Mere padar ki lahed par do gul chada Dena..
Rida Mai Phool ke Badle Chadane aayi hu.
Likhega kaise ye asmee bhi dard ka manzar...
Ye Bain Zainab e kubra ne jab kiye rokar...
Mai Teri kabr pe khud ko giraane aayi hu..
